claims.answer: Dray has no model of its own: it runs five agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, pi, fx, Grok Build) chosen per session, drives each through its own protocol, and mixes harnesses across sessions and in review. The list is fixed: no user-defined adapter exists.

sources.locator: intro; Layout; The dray CLI; Releasing
sources.finding: Desktop home for coding agents wrapping Claude Code, Codex, fx and pi in a native chat UI; many sessions, each with worktree, diff view, PR panel, issue panel and embedded browser; Tauri app (React 19 + Rust), dray CLI over ~/.dray/dray.sock; Apache-2.0 repo.

sources.title: Dray docs home
sources.finding: Runs the coding agent CLIs you already use (Claude Code, Codex, pi, fx, Grok Build) in one chat window; free and open source on the subscriptions you already have.

sources.title: Agents
sources.locator: What each one supports; Signing in; Claude Code; Codex; pi; fx; Grok Build
sources.finding: Five agent CLIs side by side with models, effort, permission modes, worktree and mid-turn behaviour; Dray installs no agent and stores no agent login; MCP servers come from each agent configuration.

sources.title: Install Dray
sources.locator: Requirements; Download; Install an agent; Dray keeps running after you quit; Limits
sources.finding: macOS 11+ universal DMG (signed and notarized); Island needs macOS 15; git needed for worktrees; folders without git still work; sessions run in a background process; Chromium for the built-in browser downloads after launch; Mac only (Linux as a server).

sources.title: Privacy
sources.locator: What is sent; DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS; Surveys; Other connections
sources.finding: Anonymous PostHog analytics on by default with no Settings switch, disabled only by DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS; prompts, code, paths and error text never sent; lists other network connections (providers, updates, GitHub/Linear, OpenTunnel, Hugging Face dictation models).

sources.title: Data on disk
sources.locator: What is in ~/.dray; What goes when you delete a session; Environment variables
sources.finding: Everything in ~/.dray (JSONL transcripts, index, attachments, drafts, credentials 0600, browser profiles); deleting a session removes transcript, attachments, browser profile and worktree; DRAY_HOME and DRAY_NO_ANALYTICS variables.

sources.title: Connect a server
sources.finding: Linux x86_64/arm64 server over SSH installs Dray as a systemd user service; agents run on the server; used through the Mac app; no browser version and no phone app yet; a Mac cannot be set up over SSH.

sources.title: Remote access and sharing
sources.locator: Sessions keep running when you quit; The server list; Remote access; Share a dev server
sources.finding: Sessions live in a background server (launchd on Mac, systemd on Linux); multiple servers in one sidebar; Remote access via OpenTunnel public address lets another Mac connect with a token; public dev-server links.

sources.title: Orchestration
sources.locator: Fan work out; Hidden sessions; Bots; Review with a second model; Messages between sessions
sources.finding: An agent runs `dray session new` to start child sessions in their own worktrees that inherit agent/model settings; hidden review sessions on another harness with --base; dray session send messages between sessions; Bots with AGENTS.md and memory.

sources.title: Issues (dray CLI)
sources.finding: dray issue link records Linear or GitHub issue tags on a session; dray never writes to the tracker.

sources.title: Issues settings
sources.locator: Connect a tracker; The Issues page
sources.finding: Linear (API key) and GitHub (gh) issues browsed in the app; status and priority can be changed from Dray; # tags issues into prompts.

sources.title: Worktrees
sources.locator: Start; Where it lives; What it starts from; Delete; Limits
sources.finding: Worktree sessions at <project>/.claude/worktrees/<name> on worktree-<name> branches from origin default; delete flows warn about uncommitted work; sessions started via dray always get a worktree.

sources.title: Permissions and questions
sources.locator: Know when an agent is waiting; Answer a permission request; Approve a plan
sources.finding: Permission and question cards with Allow once, Always allow, Deny; yellow sidebar mark, macOS notification, Dock badge; plan approval.

sources.title: Sessions and the sidebar
sources.locator: Read a row; How the list is ordered
sources.finding: Sidebar ordered by what needs the user; yellow waiting, green unread, working orb, PR glyph and checks status per session; settle, pin, fork, delete.

sources.title: Notifications
sources.locator: What Dray tells you about; Which way you hear; Cards
sources.finding: macOS banners, in-app cards, sounds for done, needs permission, needs answer and ready to merge.

sources.title: Accounts
sources.finding: Per-agent block showing who each agent CLI is signed in as (and gh), with sign-in through Terminal or an API key, sign-out and hiding an agent; no Dray-held agent credentials.

sources.title: The dray command
sources.finding: dray CLI installed by the app to ~/.local/bin with an agent skill; talks to the running app or server over a local socket; commands for sessions, drafts, issues, browser, share and servers.

sources.title: dray session
sources.finding: dray session new with flags --project, --model, --effort, --harness (claude_code, codex, pi, fx, grok), --base, --title, --issue, --fast and --hidden; run inside a session it nests the new one and inherits settings.

sources.title: Spaces
sources.finding: Spaces group projects to separate sessions and notifications; every session keeps running.

sources.title: Dray llms.txt
sources.finding: Free open-source macOS app; Apache 2.0; runs on existing subscriptions; Linux supported as a server driven from the Mac app; notch (Island) and on-device dictation.

sources.title: Apache-2.0 license
sources.finding: Apache License 2.0.

sources.title: Tauri configuration
sources.finding: Tauri macOS app version 0.30.10 with minimumSystemVersion 11.0 and identifier com.yogesh.dray.

sources.title: GitHub integration
sources.locator: gh pr merge with --squash; statusCheckRollup GraphQL (lines ~150, ~201, ~1284)
sources.finding: Reads PR checks and review comments through gh and merges with squash/merge/rebase flags through gh pr merge.

sources.title: Usage events
sources.finding: Token and cost accounting is shown only when a harness reports it (Claude Code reports USD cost; Codex never does); context gauge only when reported.

sources.title: Auto-continue on usage limit
sources.finding: Claude Code sessions that stop at the usage limit get an automatic continue after the limit resets; schedule stored on the session index entry.

sources.title: Dray Cloud control plane client
sources.finding: Client for a Dray Cloud control plane that starts machines per task; the web route stays a 404 until a build-time key is set, and neither the docs, changelog nor llms.txt announce it.

sources.title: Org link
sources.finding: Device-flow link of a server to an org at drayhq.com; unreleased org features are not described in the docs.

sources.title: GitHub repository
sources.finding: monorepo-labs/dray: Apache-2.0, homepage https://drayhq.com, pushed 2026-11-17.

sources.title: GitHub repository API
sources.finding: stargazers_count 136, Apache-2.0, pushed_at 2026-11-17T13:02:00Z.

sources.title: Release v0.30.10
sources.finding: Latest app release v0.30.10 published 2026-11-17 (commit 8798e88); v0.30.9 earlier the same day; CLI releases cli-v0.14.x are tagged separately.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.finding: Only auto_continue (usage-limit retry), updater and transcription match; no user-facing scheduler, cron, webhook or event trigger.

sources.title: Bounded search: roles, teams, SSO
sources.finding: No roles, teams or SSO in docs; server tokens and an org-link device flow exist but are not user roles.

sources.title: Bounded search: spend and token limits
sources.finding: No budget or spend cap; usage shown only as reported by harnesses.

sources.title: Bounded search: native issues
sources.finding: Issues are read from Linear and GitHub and cached; no Dray-owned issue entity; drafts are saved unstarted tasks.

sources.title: Bounded search: Windows and Linux desktop clients
sources.finding: Install docs state Mac only and distribute one macOS universal DMG; Linux is supported only as a server; tauri.conf.json sets bundle targets all but no Windows or Linux desktop download is offered; apps/gpui is a client rewrite in progress and apps/island-linux a separate component.
